integrity: All finite verification examples are checks of a separately proved uniform free-face construction. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The collapse requires a finite simple base graph with no 4-cycle. Open neighborhoods, not closed Čech neighborhoods, are used. General bases with 4-cycles and publication priority outside inspected literature are not determined.
title: Prisms over four-cycle-free graphs collapse to their bipartite double covers
